posts.author: ha_the_meow
posts.text: Well, it is temporary setback, as there was delay in some approvals. Eventually the company will get them, and he also said they are to get a big defense project. Haven’t announced it though. Hopefully it has good turnaround time as the cashflows are really bad, short term borrowing has spiked. will eat margins..

posts.author: Pratik_Shetty
posts.text: while both the company performance and stock performance has languished, the one bright spot is that MD Manoj Kumar Gupta has been on a buying spree. His ownership has increased from 48.68% in Sep 2025 to 49.40% post the latest buying on 18th August. Significant buying in July and August.
